reviews.title: Legit competition for more expensive desks!
reviews.body: Purchase the 72 x 30 Desk and love it. Purchase three drawers with it as well.  Came in two packages, one for the top and one for the hardware and legs. Assembly took me about 45 minutes which also included mounting a power strip to the underside of the Desk.  Overall appears to be very sturdy.  I stand more at my desk than I sit.  Because of the size of my monitors I may reinforce the underside of the desktop, but no issues at this time. Great solid alternative to the much more expensive standing desk on the market.

reviews.title: Very sturdy, great quality!
reviews.body: Love this desk. Assembly was actually very simple, printed directions are a bit confusing but scan the QR code to a short step-by-step video. It’s heavy so recommend someone to help flip over once built. I work 10-12+ hours a day remotely so I need to stand and walk as much as possible. Previously used a lift that sat on top of a regular desk but that made sitting awkward as it was very high off the desk top and chair positioning was a problem. Plus the weight of my electronic equipment made it very difficult to raise and lower. The height adjustment with this desk is perfect for using with a walking pad and keeping everything in reach. Very smooth.I have 2 very large monitors on individual heavy duty arms, plus 2 laptops on the desk top and it moves without hesitation. No crashing down when lowered and no rocking when lifted, even at 45+ inches and walking pad is running.I added under mount storage for cables, surge protectors and such, plus the magnetic cord bracket for the leg. Everything is perfectly hidden and the organization makes me very happy!Also, shipping was awesome, arrived within 2 days of placing the order!

reviews.title: Don’t research for weeks like I did - this is perfect!
reviews.body: Pros:• Looks fantastic — far more premium and expensive in appearance than I thought it would be• Durable, easy to clean, and the wood tone and texture feel lovely in person.• Arrived ahead of schedule — the day after I ordered, rather than the estimated 2–3 days.• Delivered together in two boxes (tabletop + frame) by the same driver — I’ve seen reviews where other brands deliver them separately and make you wait days for the second box.• Straightforward to build with well-aligned holes and clear instructions. (Apart from the A bolts, as was unsure if this was correct with there not being any clear screw holes for these and them instead just being used to secure the frame by tightening around the central bars)• Operates quietly and smoothly.• Both USB-C and USB ports charge fast and feel powerful.• I’m finally comfortable at the right desk height! Whoop whoop!• Extremely sturdy and stable, even at tall heights (see below for details).• Excellent weight capacity — you can feel how strong it is. My partner even lay on it while I tested the up/down motion!Neutral observations:• The tabletop colour shifts slightly depending on lighting and can look different than the listing images - it appears lighter and more reflective in bright daylight, and warmer walnut-toned in artificial light. Just something to be aware of if you’re trying to colour-match furniture.•  Cable management is okay, but can sometimes pop out of place when setting upCons:• The finish is a little glossier than expected — more of a soft laminate sheen than a full matte look.• Realistically, you’ll want two people for assembly (especially to carry it upstairs).• Setup takes slightly more time and patience than expected — but it’s absolutely been worth it.• The anti-collision feature is included, though not mentioned in the Amazon listing. It works fine, just not the most sensitive or instant-reacting system I’ve seen (videos and some furniture store trials).Stability and shake:I’m incredibly picky about desk wobble, and this one impressed me. I run two monitors (a 34-inch on an arm clamp and a 24-inch on a stand), a small computer, hard drives plus a lot of peripherals.• At ~70cm height, there’s virtually zero movement — I have to really push it to see any wobble.• At ~120cm, it’s still impressively solid.For context, my old fixed IKEA desk shook more even when I typed — this HomePro is leagues ahead in stability.General impressions:I spent WEEKS researching, weeks comparing specs and reviews - those wasted hours I should have trusted my gut on day one which was to buy this. Other tables in the same price range had very unknown specs and the review images rarely matched the listing images (often differences in the touch pad and frame within the same listing), the product names often didn’t match with official website listings or historical ones - so you never know what you’ll get - but with the HomePro I received the exact model shown. I think as an investment (I work from home) this is worth every penny for a table.You can tell that Desktronic is one of only a few reliable brands in this price range, there are YouTube Tutorials, clearly non-promo based reviews online, brilliant website and fantastic packaging.If you’re choosing between models, I’d definitely recommend paying the extra for the Home Pro over the Home One — the higher weight capacity and wider height range are worth it for comfort and longevity.Should you switch to a standing desk?I only realised this after purchasing the Home Pro, but If you’re ever adjusting your chair for comfort it’s an amazing thing to move the desk with you - even by a centromere or two. It’s far easier for reclining office chairs and footrests too. I discovered I really liked the table at its lowest setting where im sat above it for certain tasks. I rarely use the standing function and personally it’s been worth it for the reasons listed above alone.Conclusion:Don’t waste weeks researching like I did. This desk exceeded my expectations in every way — sturdy, stylish, reliable, and an excellent long-term investment for anyone working from home.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on October 10, 2025
